name: intel-dashboard
description: Asset Intelligence dashboard: heading and lede over a dashboard table with floating image chips and mock tip cards, then a check list and two buttons. Live: .epx-dash on the Emergency Preparedness, School Reunification, Help Desk and September 2026 solution pages.

variant.description: Which live design draws the section: readiness (Emergency Preparedness), reunification (School Reunification), service (Help Desk), solution (the six September solution pages).

title.description: Section title. Line breaks are kept.

title_accent.description: Part of the title painted with the brand gradient.

lede.description: Paragraph under the title. "UrsaAI" is drawn as the brand mark.

image_mobile.description: Taller crop shown at 1080px and below.

image_alt.description: Alt text for the table screenshot.

background_mobile.description: Backdrop at 1080px and below (falls back to background).

chips.description: Floating image chips. Each: cls (placement class from the design, e.g. epx-chip--g or sp-chip--1), image, boxed (true when the chip is a frame holding the image rather than the image itself), framed (true when the image sits in an inner circle).

tips.description: Floating mock UI cards. Each: cls (the card's own classes, e.g. epx-tip--t3 or sp-tip--1), height (px, optional), markup (the card body; sanitised by ap_ui_markup).

check_svg.description: Inline SVG tick drawn before each check.

chips_anchor.description: What the chips are pinned to (solution variant). section: the section wrap, as on the live pages. dashboard: the table stage at the design's offsets, so the chips move with the dashboard when the heading wraps to more lines and scale with it on tablets.

head_width.description: Max width of the heading column in px (solution variant; 0 keeps the design's 656px).

check_width.description: Width of each check column in px (solution variant; 0 keeps the design's).

checks.description: Short benefit lines under the dashboard.

ctas.description: Buttons; the first is solid, the rest outlined. Each: label, url. "UrsaAI" is drawn as the brand mark.
